defects.description: The payment is performed before the ledger checkpoint without passing the job's stable idempotency key. A declined ledger commit followed by a retry duplicates the external payment while crediting the account only once.

trigger.input: MemoryLedger accepts only its second commit; run job {id:'a',account:'red',amount:12} twice through the same payment adapter, recreating BillingJob between runs.
trigger.expected: statuses retry,complete; one external charge and account balance 12
trigger.actual: statuses retry,complete; two external charges and account balance 12

defects.why_missed: The suite tests completed-job replay and a single declined commit independently, never retrying a job after a successful external payment and declined internal checkpoint.

defects.description: The major-unit job amount is rounded directly and passed to the minor-unit payment API without scaling by 100, silently undercharging while recording the full account credit.

trigger.input: Run job {id:'b',account:'blue',amount:12.34} against accepting MemoryLedger and inspect payments.charges[0].minorUnits.

defects.why_missed: Happy-path assertions check internal balances, receipt association, account selection and charge counts, but not the amount sent across the payment adapter's unit boundary.
